renderer: ADOP-style nearest one-pixel forward, fuzzy depth test 1%, mean of accepted fixed RGB
backward: ADOP paper section 3.1 and official mode-4 neighbor insertion formula; symmetric left/right up/down pixel influences, perspective Jacobian; no direct depth-compositing gradient
omitted: stochastic point discarding and ghost dropout
approximation_scope: local implementation of ADOP one-pixel/neighbor gradient ideas, not a reproduction of full ADOP or its ghost-dropout training configuration
train_mask: frozen E0d initial coverage intersect initial raw predicted depth-edge/confidence mask and three-pixel border; missing pixels stay in loss
active_set: unchanged E0d multi-source/parallax/source-visibility policy, arm-specific indices
position_parameter: same owner-ray log distance as E3c
optimizer: Adam; retained E3c settings to isolate renderer/backward change; original ADOP uses SGD for point positions
selection: minimum fixed-mask RGB Charbonnier at checkpoint steps, never GT
validation: known one-pixel/depth/mean cases; independent neighbor insertion gradient cases; perspective-chain Jacobian; actual discrete scene-loss probes. Surrogate is not required to equal infinitesimal forward finite differences
gt_evaluation: matched LiDAR and pose metadata retained, conventions unvalidated; no GT accuracy or metric scale evaluation
outdoor_scope: same-input three-frame paired rendering; not independent full-3D or heldout validation
